bill.title: Directing the Clerk of the House of Representatives to make a correction in the engrossment of H.R. 7147.
bill.latestActionText: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.

classification.plainSummary:
Directing the Clerk of the House of Representatives to make a correction in the engrossment of H.R. 7147.

This is a simple resolution concerning the operation of Congress. It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
